about: Scheduled events beyond FOMC/CPI/NFP for docs/research/macro_factors.md (study: scripts/macro_factors_test.py). utc = local time converted with the official zone rules (America/New_York, Europe/Berlin, Asia/Tokyo). status: released (≤ 2026-10-17), scheduled (official future schedule), cancelled.

sources.deribit: https://www.deribit.com/kb/deribit-introduction-to-options (expiry: 08:00 UTC; monthly = last Friday; quarterly = Mar/Jun/Sep/Dec)

caveats: BoJ: the announcement time is not fixed (≈11:30–13:00 JST); the study uses a 4-hour window 02:00–06:00 UTC around the nominal 12:00 JST.
BoJ 2021–2025 decision days are from the BoJ yearly schedules (boj.or.jp, mref pages); 2026 dates cross-checked with a secondary calendar; 2027 from the BoJ PDF of 31.07.2026.
ECB 2021–2026 decision days are the ECB Governing Council monetary policy meetings (ecb.europa.eu); 2027 from the ECB press release of 30.06.2026 (reserve maintenance calendar).
PCE/GDP/PPI: actual release dates incl. the 2025 shutdown delays (BEA schedule pages and blog notices of 07.01.2026 and 15.01.2026; BLS PPI archive and historical release-date PDF).
CRYPTO_POLICY: day from congress.gov / SEC / news reports; the clock time is approximate (floor vote or announcement), use ±several hours.
Jackson Hole 2026: symposium 27–29 Aug 2026 (KC Fed); speech time 10:00 ET is the usual slot (press previews), not on the KC Fed page.
Token unlocks: no free source with history — not included.
